# Classification accuracy (held-out)

**Generated by `./hack/benchmark-report`. Do not edit by hand.**

Every figure below comes from a held-out evaluation set that was authored by hand,
independently of any training corpus, and checked for verbatim overlap against both the
anchors and the training data. The generator asserts zero leakage and fails the run if any
training row duplicates a held-out prompt.

Method: embed the input, score each label by the mean cosine similarity of its top-3
nearest anchors, take the argmax. `baseline-minilm` is the un-finetuned
`sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` scored against the SAME anchors, which isolates
the contribution of fine-tuning from the contribution of the anchor set.

All numbers were produced on a single homelab machine (Apple M-series CPU, single thread)
and have NOT been independently reproduced.
